title: Grassy Terrain

sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Meadow, Plains, Savanna, and Sunflower Plains.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Fairy Wind, Grass Knot, Gust, Icy Wind, Ominous Wind, Razor Wind, Silver Wind, and Twister: 1.5× stronger.
Bulldoze, Earthquake, Magnitude, Muddy Water, and Surf: halved (0.5×).

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Grass-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Acid Downpour and Sludge Wave change the field into Corrosive.
Muddy Water and Surf change the field into Swamp once their uses add up to 3 (Muddy Water 2 and Surf 1).

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Sap Sipper restores 1/16 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Defense +1 and takes root (Ingrain).

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
